title: eludite.workspace.rename input
description: Rename a file or folder in place, as the Workspace window's Rename (F2) does. All or nothing (brief 0073, the workspace-edit applier's rules): every source must exist, no target may exist, nothing moves into itself, and no open document among the touched files may have unsaved changes; otherwise nothing changes and `message` says why. The disk work runs off the UI thread; open tabs follow a rename or move and close on a delete; every language server gets workspace/didChangeWatchedFiles; projects that name the paths in their project file are edited by the host (eludite/project/editItems) and the tree is refreshed.

path.description: Absolute path, or relative to the workspace folder.

name.description: The new name: a file or folder name, no path separators.

renameSymbol.description: For a C#, VB or F# file named after a type it declares (Foo.cs declaring Foo): also rename the type and its references through the language server (eludite.editor.rename at the declaration), as Visual Studio offers. Default false; the person is asked.
